items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: naturally, we become good chums anyway; I mean, I knew him anyway.

ctx.x: I'll continue by asking you to flesh out portraits of musicians who may have not been in the spotlight. Somebody like Rupert Cole.

Oh, Rupert Cole, alto player, clarinetist. He was a very good musician. He joined the band, I don't know exactly when, what the date was, he had some pretty stiff music to put in front of him when he joined the band.
